cases.name: Susan Ann Wickersham
cases.about: She was was born and raised in Bend, OR and had just finished her junior year at Bend High School. She was described by her friends as a likeable young lady with a bubbly outgoing personality.
cases.narrative: On 1/20/1976 her skeletal remains and some personal items were found by a wood cutter approximately five miles south of Bend, OR in a wooded area behind a weigh station on Hwy 97.
